name: browser-use
headline: llm-agents.nix - Nix Packages for AI Coding Agents
short_description: Nix packages for AI coding agents and development tools. Automatically updated daily. Enables operations teams to streamline workflows, reduce setup time, and ensure consistent environments. Integrates with buildbot-numtide for CI/CD pipelines.
author: numtide

sections.overview:
llm-agents.nix provides a curated collection of Nix packages for AI coding agents and development tools, maintained by Numtide with automated daily updates. The project integrates with buildbot-numtide for CI/CD pipeline automation, enabling operations teams to reduce setup time and maintain reproducible environments across deployments. By packaging tools like Codex and other AI development utilities, llm-agents.nix eliminates dependency conflicts and simplifies onboarding for teams using AI-assisted coding workflows. The repository uses Nix flakes and overlays to provide flexible integration patterns, whether you need pre-built cache hits or customized builds against your own nixpkgs pin. This approach particularly benefits DevOps teams and development operations seeking to standardize AI tooling across multiple machines and environments.
Automate repetitive coding tasks using AI agents to save time and reduce errors.
Integrate various AI coding tools to enhance code quality and streamline development workflows.
Leverage AI capabilities for faster debugging and code optimization.
Utilize terminal-based coding agents for real-time coding assistance and suggestions.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/numtide/llm-agents.nix`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
